title: LayerNorm 手算与残差连接梯度路径示意
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
x = rng.standard_normal(6) * 3.0
gamma = np.ones(6); beta = np.zeros(6)
eps = 1e-5
mu = x.mean(); var = x.var()
xhat = (x - mu) / np.sqrt(var + eps)
yn = gamma * xhat + beta
print("输入 x:", np.round(x, 4))
print("均值 mu:", round(float(mu), 6), " 方差 var:", round(float(var), 6))
print("xhat 均值:", round(float(xhat.mean()), 6), " 方差:", round(float(xhat.var()), 6))
print("LayerNorm 输出:", np.round(yn, 4))
grad_identity = 1.0
print("残差恒等路径梯度(即使 LN 梯度=0 仍有):", grad_identity)
print("残差使梯度最小为1:", True)
